title: Network Delay Time
prompt: You are given a network of n nodes, labeled from 1 to n. You are also given times, a list of travel times as directed edges times[i] = (ui, vi, wi), where ui is the source node, vi is the target node, and wi is the time it takes for a signal to travel from source to target. We will send a signal from a given node k. Return the minimum time it takes for all the n nodes to receive the signal. If it is impossible for all nodes to receive the signal, return -1.
hints: Dijkstra from node k. Return max of shortest distances to all nodes. If any node unreachable, return -1.
Build adj: u -> [(v, w)]. Min-heap (dist, node). Pop min, relax neighbors. Track best dist per node.
